We need to respond to user: "[request short-1] Write a short paragraph explaining what a GPU does and why memory bandwidth matters." Need final short paragraph. Simple.
||A GPU is a specialized processor designed to perform many calculations in parallel, especially for graphics, video, machine learning, and other data-intensive tasks. Instead of handling one operation at a time like a typical CPU, a GPU can process many operations simultaneously, making it much faster for certain workloads. Memory bandwidth matters because a GPU can only perform calculations as fast as it can receive data from memory. If bandwidth is low, the GPU may sit idle waiting for data, limiting overall performance even if it has many powerful cores.
